incidents.title: Delayed card withdrawal processing
incidents.text: From 10:20 to 12:45 UTC some withdrawal requests were processed with a delay due to degradation on the payment provider's side. All requests have been executed and funds credited.

incidents.title: Scheduled trading API maintenance
incidents.text: On the night of June 29–30 (01:00–02:30 UTC, markets closed) the execution infrastructure was upgraded. Downtime was 12 minutes within the announced window.
